name: nucleation_manual_engine_quiet_click
description: The designed behaviour, isolated from placement side effects: knownShape placement dispatches nothing — the machine sits completely still, QC-powered piston included, for ten ticks — and the click at the note block's *as-built* position then runs exactly one activation: two steps, starting at ticks 10 and 19, nine game ticks apart.
